board.name: Florida Board of Medicine (Council on Physician Assistants)

licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA) licence
licence.renewalDeadline: January 31 of each even-numbered year (midnight ET)

ce.categoryRules: At least 50 hours Category I (AAPA, ACCME, AMA, AOA, or AAFP approved); remaining 50 may be Category II. Mandated topic hours count inside the 100.
ce.acceptsNccpaCertificationInLieuNote: Current NCCPA certification at renewal substitutes for the general hours (board page: 98 general hours, or 97 at first renewal); the mandated topics (medical errors, domestic violence when due, HIV/AIDS at first renewal, prescriber hours) must still be documented.

topicMandates.topic: HIV/AIDS (Category I, must include Florida law)
Specialty area(s) of the supervising physician(s)
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs with prescriptive privileges; counts toward the 100 (Rule 64B8-30.005(6): 'These hours may be utilized to meet the general continuing education requirement')

topicMandates.topic: Safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances (part of the 10 specialty hours)

topicMandates.appliesTo: ch. 458 licensees incl. PAs; statute deadline 'By January 1, 2021', hour counts inside total CE (s. 456.0341(2)); not listed on the board's PA renewal CE table, so treatment of PAs licensed after 2021 is not confirmed

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 3 hours every biennium on safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances, within the 10 specialty hours, for PAs with prescriptive privileges; course must come from a statewide professional association of physicians in Florida accredited for AMA PRA Category 1 (or AAPA Category 1 / AOA 1-A).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Supervising physician must notify the Department on a department form of intent to delegate prescriptive authority before delegating, and of any change in prescriptive privileges. Renewal requires current primary practice address; no periodic agreement re-filing found in the sources loaded.
practice.notes: Prescribing PAs pay a prescribing registration ($10 add-on shown on board renewal page) at renewal. Rule 64B8-30.005 effective 6/22/2026.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Prescribing registration / prescriber number obtained through the licence (checkbox on renewal application); supervising physician files notice of delegation.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 10 hours in supervising physician specialty incl. 3 hours controlled substance prescribing, every biennium
prescribing.chronicPainDesignation: s. 456.44(2): a PA (or APRN) who prescribes Schedule II, III or IV controlled substances for chronic nonmalignant pain must designate himself or herself as a controlled substance prescribing practitioner on the practitioner profile. This is a designation, not a separate state CS registration.

facts.quote: A Physician Assistant must renew his licensure on a biennial basis.

facts.cite: Board of Medicine PA renewal page
facts.quote: All physician assistant licenses expire at midnight, Eastern Time, January 31, of each even year, unless renewed.
Completion of 100 hours of Continuing Medical Education in the previous two (2) years or documentation that the licensee is certified
A minimum of 50 hours must be Category I Continuing Medical Education approved by the American Academy of Physician Assistants

facts.cite: Board of Medicine PA renewal page
facts.quote: A current NCCPA certification can substitute for the 97 general CME hours.
Completion of two hours of continuing medical education relating to prevention of medical errors
As part of every third biennial renewal licensure period, all licensees shall complete two (2) hours of training in domestic violence
Upon a licensee's first renewal of licensure, the licensee must document the completion of one (1) hour of Category I
all physician assistants with prescriptive privileges shall complete a minimum of 10 hours of continuing education in the specialty area(s) of the supervising physician(s)
Three of the 10 hours must consist of a continuing education course on the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substance medications
By January 1, 2021, each licensee or certificateholder shall complete a board-approved ... 1-hour continuing education course on human trafficking.
facts.note: s. 456.0341(2) requires the hour to be counted inside the total CE hours. Applies to ch. 458 licensees (PAs). Text is a one-time 'By January 1, 2021' deadline; how the board applies it to PAs licensed after 2021 is not stated on the PA renewal page.

facts.quote: The supervising physician must notify the department of his or her intent to delegate, on a department-approved form, before delegating such authority
Each licensed physician assistant shall biennially complete 100 hours of continuing medical education or shall hold a current certificate issued by the National Commission

facts.value: 10 hours with each licensure renewal, 3 on controlled substances
facts.quote: complete a minimum of 10 continuing medical education hours in the specialty practice in which the physician assistant has prescriptive privileges with each licensure renewal

facts.value: HIV/AIDS course no later than first renewal; applies to ch. 458 and part I ch. 464 licensees
facts.quote: Each person shall be required by the appropriate board to complete no later than upon first renewal a continuing educational course

facts.value: 2 hours every third biennial renewal; ch. 458 and part I ch. 464
facts.quote: to complete a 2-hour continuing education course, approved by the board, on domestic violence

facts.value: s. 456.0301 2 hour DEA prescriber course does not apply to PAs or APRNs (their practice acts require 3 hours)
facts.quote: This paragraph does not apply to a licensee who is required by his or her applicable practice act to complete a minimum of 2 hours

facts.value: PAs and APRNs prescribing Schedule II-IV for chronic nonmalignant pain must designate themselves on the practitioner profile
facts.quote: Designate himself or herself as a controlled substance prescribing practitioner on his or her practitioner profile.

rn.renewalDeadline: Biennial, in three renewal groups at midnight ET: Group 1 April 30, 2028; Group 2 July 31, 2028; Group 3 April 30, 2027 (RN and APRN pages list the same groups)
rn.notes: 1 contact hour per calendar month of the licensure cycle (24 for a full biennium). Nurses certified by an NCCA or ABSNC accredited specialty program are exempt from the general CE, but not from the 2 hour human trafficking course (or, for APRNs, the 3 hour controlled substance course).

aprn.title: APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse); optional Autonomous APRN registration
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: separate APRN licence (plus active RN licence)
aprn.ceNote: RN CE (1 contact hour per month, 24 for a full biennium) satisfies both licences; up to 50% may be CME (Rule 64B9-5.002(4)). APRNs add the 3 hour controlled substance course every biennium within the 30 hour statutory cap. Board APRN table: 16 general + medical errors 2 + laws and rules 2 + human trafficking 2 + impairment 2 (every other biennium) + controlled substances 3 = 27 in a biennium when impairment is due. Domestic violence (2, every third biennium): the board page says these hours are in addition to the 24, while Rule 64B9-5.002(2) lists it among courses that are a mandatory part of the hours; this conflict is unresolved. Autonomous APRNs: 10 additional hours on top of 30 hours of CE (s. 464.0123(5)(b)).

topicMandates.topic: Safe and effective prescription of controlled substances
topicMandates.appliesTo: all APRNs (not waived by certification exemption)

topicMandates.topic: Additional board-approved CE for autonomous registration (graduate level per Rule 64B9-4.020(4))
topicMandates.appliesTo: registered Autonomous APRNs only; in addition to the 30 hours of CE under s. 464.013, and the NCCA/ABSNC certification exemption does not remove it

aprn.nationalCertificationNote: Conditional: the renewal page requires a copy of current national certification from licensees who were required to be nationally certified at original licensure.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate prescriptive authority registration found; APRN prescribes within the supervisory protocol (or under autonomous registration for primary care). Dispensing requires a separate dispensing registration.
prescribing.chronicPainDesignation: s. 456.44(2): a PA (or APRN) who prescribes Schedule II, III or IV controlled substances for chronic nonmalignant pain must designate himself or herself as a controlled substance prescribing practitioner on the practitioner profile. This is a designation, not a separate state CS registration.

practice.agreementType: supervisory protocol with a physician (unless registered as Autonomous APRN for primary care)
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Protocol maintained on site at each practice location; the physician files notice of the protocol with the Board of Medicine within 30 days of entering it and within 30 days after terminating it. Autonomous APRN registration (primary care only) requires 3,000 supervised clinical hours in the prior 5 years plus graduate pharmacology and differential diagnosis coursework; renewed with the APRN licence with updated financial responsibility form.

facts.quote: During each biennium, one contact hour must be earned for each calendar month of the licensure cycle.

facts.cite: Board of Nursing RN renewal page
facts.quote: Group 3 – current license will expire at midnight, Eastern Standard Time, April 30, 2027

facts.value: 10 hours in addition to 30 hours of CE, regardless of certification exemption
facts.quote: must complete at least 10 hours of continuing education approved by the board, in addition to completing 30 hours of continuing education requirements

facts.quote: Autonomous Advanced Practice Registered Nurse are not required to renew their Florida RN license; it is optional.

unverified: Florida practitioner CS registration: no general state controlled substance registration for PAs or APRNs was found; s. 456.44(2) chronic pain designation is confirmed. stateCsRegistrationRequired left null (absence not confirmed by a primary source).

PA human trafficking: s. 456.0341 applies to ch. 458 licensees (PAs) with a one-time 'By January 1, 2021' deadline; the board's PA renewal CE table omits it, so treatment of PAs licensed after 2021 is not confirmed.
Nurse domestic violence hours: board page says the 2 hours are in addition to 24; Rule 64B9-5.002(2) says they are part of the hours. Unresolved.

Autonomous APRN base CE: s. 464.0123(5)(b) says 10 hours in addition to 30 hours of CE; the board page shows the general 24 hour table plus 10. The base (24 vs 30) for autonomous registrants is not resolved by a board statement.
AANP-style 'restricted' practice label is a classification, not a Florida term; the statutory facts (supervisory protocol, autonomous primary care option after 3,000 hours) are confirmed.

No general APRN pharmacology hour requirement found beyond the 3 hour controlled substance course (autonomous registration requires 3 graduate semester hours of pharmacology at registration, s. 464.0123(1)(d), not per cycle).
Federal DEA MATE 8 hour one-time training is federal, not Florida law; not loaded in this verification.

corrections: np.rn.renewalDeadline: researcher said 'April 30 or July 31'; the RN and APRN renewal pages list THREE groups (April 30 2028, July 31 2028, April 30 2027). Group 3 renews in odd years.

Autonomous APRN CE: researcher listed only '+10 graduate-level hours'. s. 464.0123(5)(b) requires the 10 hours IN ADDITION TO 30 hours of CE under s. 464.013, 'regardless of whether the registrant is otherwise required' (i.e. the certification exemption does not apply to an autonomous registrant). Added fact; the board page's general table still shows the 24 hour RN schedule, so the 30 vs 24 base for autonomous registrants is flagged unverified-by-board.
Added: board page states autonomous APRNs are not required to renew the Florida RN licence (optional). Researcher implied RN + APRN always both renew.
np.aprn.nationalCertificationRequired: refined to conditional wording (board page: licensees 'who were required to be nationally certified, at the time of original licensure').

Domestic violence for nurses: board page says the 2 DV hours are in addition to the 24; Rule 64B9-5.002(2) says the listed courses are 'a mandatory part of the hours'. Recorded as an unresolved primary-source conflict (verified:false) rather than the researcher's one-sided note.
PA HIV/AIDS: researcher left s. 456.033 status unchecked; the 2026 Florida Statutes text is current and applies to ch. 458 (PAs) and part I of ch. 464 (nurses). Unverified item resolved.

Checked missed mandate: s. 456.0301 (2 hour controlled substance course for every DEA registrant, amended by ch. 2026-6) exempts licensees whose practice act already requires 2+ hours; PA (3 hours, s. 458.347(4)(e)4.) and APRN (3 hours, s. 464.013(3)(b)) are therefore not double-counted. Added as a fact.

Added missed item: s. 456.44(2) chronic nonmalignant pain prescriber designation on the practitioner profile (applies to PAs and APRNs). stateCsRegistrationRequired stays null: no general Florida practitioner CS registration was found, but absence is not confirmed by a primary source.
